use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES

use Cell = (row: int, column: int)
use Shape = List[Cell]

let size = 8

let pieces = [
    ('F', [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 1)]),
    ('I', [(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (4, 0)]),
    ('L', [(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (3, 0), (3, 1)]),
    ('N', [(0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0), (3, 0)]),
    ('P', [(0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0)]),
    ('T', [(0, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 1), (2, 1)]),
    ('U', [(0, 0), (0, 2), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2)]),
    ('V', [(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0), (2, 1), (2, 2)]),
    ('W', [(0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 1), (2, 2)]),
    ('X', [(0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1)]),
    ('Y', [(0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (2, 1), (3, 1)]),
    ('Z', [(0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1), (2, 1), (2, 2)])
]

reading_order(a: Cell, b: Cell) -> int =>
    if a.row != b.row then a.row - b.row else a.column - b.column fi

anchored(cells: Iterable[Cell]) -> Shape is
    let sorted =
        cells
            |> sort(reading_order)
            |> collect_list()

    let first = sorted[0]

    sorted
        |> map(c => cell_at(c.row - first.row, c.column - first.column))
        |> collect_list()
si

cell_at(row: int, column: int) -> Cell => (row = row, column = column)

key(shape: Shape) -> string =>
    shape |> map(c => "{c.row},{c.column}") |> join(" ")

orientations(cells: List[(int, int)]) -> List[Shape] is
    let found = LIST[Shape]()
    let current mut =
        cells |> map(((r, c)) => cell_at(r, c)) |> collect_list()

    for _ in 0..4 do
        for flip in [false, true] do
            let turned =
                anchored(current |> map(c =>
                    if flip then cell_at(c.row, -c.column) else c fi))

            if !(found |> any(f => key(f) =~ key(turned))) then
                found.add(turned)
            fi
        od

        current =
            current |> map(c => cell_at(c.column, -c.row)) |> collect_list()
    od

    found
si

let shapes =
    pieces
        |> map(((name, cells)) => (name, orientations(cells)))
        |> collect_list()
let board = repeat('.', size * size) |> collect_list()
let used = repeat(false, pieces.count) |> collect_list()

fits(shape: Shape, at: Cell) -> bool =>
    shape |> all(c =>
        let r = at.row + c.row, col = at.column + c.column in
        r >= 0 /\ r < size /\ col >= 0 /\ col < size /\
        board[r * size + col] == '.')

mark(shape: Shape, at: Cell, name: char) is
    for c in shape do
        board[(at.row + c.row) * size + at.column + c.column] = name
    od
si

tile() -> bool is
    let next = board.index_of('.')

    if next < 0 then
        return true
    fi

    let at = (row = next / size, column = next % size)

    for (i, (name, turns)) in shapes |> index() do
        if !used[i] then
            for shape in turns do
                if fits(shape, at) then
                    mark(shape, at, name)
                    used[i] = true

                    if tile() then
                        return true
                    fi

                    used[i] = false
                    mark(shape, at, '.')
                fi
            od
        fi
    od

    false
si

let random = System.Random(8)
let attempts mut = 0

do
    attempts = attempts + 1

    for i in 0..size * size do
        board[i] = '.'
    od

    let holes mut = 0

    while holes < 4 do
        let spot = random.next(size * size)

        if board[spot] == '.' then
            board[spot] = '-'
            holes = holes + 1
        fi
    od

    if tile() then
        break
    fi
od

write_line("tiled on attempt {attempts}:")
write_line("")

for row in 0..size do
    let cells = (0..size) |> map(c => "{board[row * size + c]}")

    write_line(cells |> join(" "))
od

let hues = "FILNPTUVWXYZ"

colour(name: char) -> (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte) =>
    let h = cast double(hues.index_of(name)) / 12.0D * 6.0D in
    let f = h - System.Math.floor(h) in
    let i = cast int(h) in
    let up = cast ubyte(90.0D + 150.0D * f) in
    let down = cast ubyte(240.0D - 150.0D * f) in
    case i
    when 0 then (red = 240ub, green = up, blue = 90ub)
    when 1 then (red = down, green = 240ub, blue = 90ub)
    when 2 then (red = 90ub, green = 240ub, blue = up)
    when 3 then (red = 90ub, green = down, blue = 240ub)
    when 4 then (red = up, green = 90ub, blue = 240ub)
    else (red = 240ub, green = 90ub, blue = down)
    esac

let cell = 40.0D
let image = IMAGE(320, 320)
let tiles = SHAPES()

image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 245ub)

for i in 0..size * size do
    let name = board[i]

    if name != '-' then
        let x = cell * cast double(i % size)
        let y = cell * cast double(i / size)

        tiles.add(
            [
                (x = x, y = y), (x = x + cell, y = y),
                (x = x + cell, y = y + cell), (x = x, y = y + cell)
            ],
            colour(name))
    fi
od

image.fill(tiles)
image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 30ub)
image.stroke(2.5D)

for i in 0..size * size do
    let r = i / size, c = i % size
    let x = cell * cast double(c), y = cell * cast double(r)

    if c + 1 < size /\ board[i] != board[i + 1] then
        image.line(x + cell, y, x + cell, y + cell)
    fi

    if r + 1 < size /\ board[i] != board[i + size] then
        image.line(x, y + cell, x + cell, y + cell)
    fi
od

image.write("pentominoes.png")

image.show("pentominoes.png")
